notes.title: Vortigon is back!
notes.content:
Some of you have had trouble getting Vortigon to unlock after completing all achievements, which should now be fixed. Lmk in the comments if you're still having issues. Other fixes in this build:

• Bug fix: When in fullscreen, the glass shatter effect is glitched when returning to main menu after losing a campaign match
• Bug fix: Muzzle flash on guns not showing
• Bug fix: Game over is sometimes triggered in survival mode when killing an opponent

notes.title: A couple of improvements
notes.content:
Windowed mode added! You can now toggle between windowed/fullscreen in the settings menus for both games, or by clicking the icon in the bottom right corner of the home screen.
Improved level/character sharing! It now works like it did in the original game, where you copy and paste the codes into text boxes.
